fact: On 13 May 2026 Libya's Ministry of Social Affairs deposited the Q2 2026 wife-and-children grant funds at the Central Bank and said it would send beneficiary lists to banking operations to transfer the amounts to beneficiaries' accounts at commercial banks.
title: إيداع مخصصات منحة الزوجة والأولاد بحساب الشؤون الاجتماعية بالمصرف المركزي
